# Code Generated by Sidekick is for learning and experimentation purposes only.

# Stage 1 — create EKS cluster and all AWS infrastructure only
# (skips kubectl/helm/kubernetes resources that need a live cluster)
terraform apply \
  -target=module.eks \
  -target=module.vpc \
  -target=aws_iam_role.karpenter_controller \
  -target=aws_iam_role.karpenter_node \
  -target=aws_sqs_queue.karpenter_interruption \
  --auto-approve

# Stage 2 — once cluster is up, apply everything else
# (kubectl provider now has a live endpoint to connect to)
terraform apply --auto-approve
